# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Thursday, November 5, 2026

*Thursday edition, compiled before the market opens. Equity, index, rupee and flow numbers are Wednesday 4 November closes; gold spot and Brent are the latest prints. IBJA's 5 November AM rate had not been published when this was compiled, so the IBJA rows show Wednesday's PM rate. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed gold-loan peer.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD bids stood at 2.55x on the closing day
Bids for Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I public NCD stood at 2.55x the ₹200 crore base at 17:00 on 4 Nov, up from 2.36x a day earlier; retail was at 2.32x, HNI 3.62x, NII 1.35x and institutional 0.01x. BSE's cumulative bid sheet showed 254.51% at 17:00 on 4 Nov, and the issue closes today.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: bids of 2.55x the base equal about ₹510 crore against the ₹500 crore issue size, so the green-shoe portion is covered on 4 Nov figures; allotment is due on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov.
Source: [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)


| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Open, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; closes today ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)) | 2026-11-04 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf | 2026-11-04 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-04 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-04 |
| Bids | 2.55x (17:00 IST); BSE cumulative 254.51% ([BSE](https://beta.bseindia.com/markets/publicIssues/DisplayIPO.aspx?IPONo=8058&id=4903&idtype=1&startdt=23%2FOct%2F2026&status=L&type=DPI)) | 2026-11-04 |

### Gold jumps over 3% after the US midterms; listed gold lenders rally up to 7%
Spot gold was up 3.4% at $4,059.95 an ounce at 19:04 GMT on 4 Nov, heading for its biggest daily gain since mid-August, as the dollar fell after Democrats won both houses of the US Congress. On NSE, Muthoot Finance (peer) closed 7.18% higher at ₹2,709.80, IIFL Finance rose 6.77% and Manappuram Finance 3.13%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for today rose ₹315 to ₹11,026 a gram, which raises the maximum per-gram amount gold lenders may lend today. The rally coincides with the last day of Muthoot Fincorp's NCD issue.
Source: [Reuters via Investing.com](https://au.investing.com/news/economy-news/gold-firms-on-softer-oil-prices-us-midterm-results-awaited-4739840)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

### Muthoot Capital Services among October's larger NBFC bond issuers
ETBFSI Research lists Muthoot Capital Services, a separate listed Muthoot Pappachan Group company, alongside Bajaj Finance, Poonawalla Fincorp, Sundaram Finance and Jio Credit as the largest NBFC private-placement borrowers in October. NBFCs as a whole raised ₹24,457 crore, down 19% from September.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a group company is placing debt in a rising-yield month, so investors may compare group paper; Muthoot Fincorp's retail NCD coupons sit against a private-placement curve that has moved up since September.
Source: [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/nbfc-bond-fundraising-falls-19-as-rising-yields-raise-borrowing-costs/135518960)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Sensex up 0.50% for a fifth straight gain; Nifty Financial Services up 0.88%
The Sensex closed at 77,301.40 on 4 Nov, up 383.55 points, and the Nifty 50 rose 0.63% to 23,960.60. Nifty Financial Services gained 0.88% to 25,580.60, and the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index rose 1.40% to 29,942.85.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: non-bank lenders beat the wider market for a second day, which helps the comparison set for the IPO.
Source: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_04112026.csv)

### Peers: Shriram Finance +2.71%, Bajaj Finance +2.47%; Muthoot Microfin (subsidiary) +3.23%
On NSE, Shriram Finance closed at ₹908.75 (+2.71%) and Bajaj Finance at ₹994.00 (+2.47%). Muthoot Microfin rose ₹4.79 (3.23%) to ₹153.07 ahead of today's Q2 board meeting.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the subsidiary's results today will feed into Muthoot Fincorp's consolidated Q2 numbers.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_04112026.csv)

### FIIs buy a provisional ₹7,284.03 crore, a fourth straight day
Provisional exchange data show FIIs net bought ₹7,284.03 crore of Indian equities on 4 Nov, their fourth straight day of buying, while DIIs net sold ₹3,712.23 crore. CNBC-TV18 puts FII buying above ₹20,000 crore over the four days.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: foreign money is coming back into Indian equities, which is good for the IPO window. It has no direct effect on NCD pricing.
Source: [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-invest-over-rs20000-crore-in-four-days-as-markets-rise-for-fifth-straight-session-20027245.htm)

### Rupee closes at 94.64; Brent falls 8.7% to $94.62
Reuters reports the rupee closed at 94.64 per dollar on 4 Nov, slightly firmer than 94.74 in the previous session. Brent fell 8.7% to settle at $94.62 a barrel, as markets bet the election result makes a US deal with Iran more likely.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: an oil drop this large, if it lasts, weakens the case for the December rate hike the market is pricing, and that hike is what is pushing up bank-line costs.
Source: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/oil-price-iran-war-us-election-strait-hormuz.html)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### SEBI moves KYC for non-resident individual clients online
SEBI circular HO/38/30/12(3)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25175/2026 of 4 Nov lets market intermediaries complete KYC digitally for individual clients resident outside India, without the client being physically in India. It applies from 3 Dec 2026.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none for lending. Non-resident investors in its listed NCDs may find demat onboarding easier from December.
Source: [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/review-of-know-your-client-process-for-individual-person-resident-outside-india-clients_105603.html)

### No new NBFC circular from RBI on 4 Nov
RBI's notification feed has nothing after the 2 Nov FEMA amendment. Its 4 Nov press releases cover routine market operations and the reconstitution of the Technical Consultative Committee for Financial Markets.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no new compliance action today.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63914)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No significant developments today.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

### CRISIL assigns AA-/Stable to Lendingkart Finance's ₹150 crore NCDs
On 4 Nov CRISIL assigned AA-/Stable to Lendingkart Finance's new ₹150 crore NCDs and reaffirmed its other ratings, citing majority ownership by Fullerton Financial Holdings. It also withdrew a ₹150 crore commercial paper rating at the company's request.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: an unsecured MSME lender rated AA- mainly on parent support sits one notch below Muthoot Fincorp's CRISIL AA. Debt investors comparing the two are comparing different bases.
Source: [CRISIL Ratings](https://www.crisilratings.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/LendingkartFinanceLimited_November%2004_%202026_RR_409071.html)

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### NBFC bond raising falls 19% in October as yields hit a four-year high
NBFCs raised ₹24,457 crore through private placements in October, down from ₹30,034 crore in September, and AAA issuers took about 68% of all corporate bond money. The 10-year G-sec touched 7.4983% on 3 Nov, its highest since October 2022, and three-year NABARD yields rose to 8.30–8.33% from 7.88–7.90%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: with AAA names taking most of the money, an AA issuer pays up in placements. Against that, Muthoot Fincorp is currently raising money through a retail public NCD.
Source: [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/nbfc-bond-fundraising-falls-19-as-rising-yields-raise-borrowing-costs/135518960)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

No significant developments today.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Thursday: MSME & commercial lending

### Update: NBFCs swap revolving MSME lines for term loans before RBI's final rule
ET reports that Bajaj Finance started term-loan variants without redraw on 1 Nov, and Tata Capital is piloting replacements for its flexi loans, about 90% of which go to MSMEs. Shriram Finance's Umesh Revankar puts revolving credit across NBFCs at about ₹2 lakh crore against a total book of roughly ₹30 lakh crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: business-loan products with a redraw feature, at any lender, would need term-loan versions if RBI's August draft becomes final.
Source: [The Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/nbfcs-redesign-lending-models-ahead-of-revolving-credit-curbs/articleshow/135512499.cms)

### Lendingkart lifts its MSME ticket size to ₹17 lakh and plans LAP
CRISIL's 4 Nov rationale says Lendingkart's average ticket on new unsecured MSME loans rose to ₹17 lakh from ₹6–7 lakh, with physical checks added to credit appraisal. It plans a secured loan-against-property product this fiscal.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: fintech MSME lenders are moving up-ticket and into LAP, where Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP also plans growth, which points to more competition for the same small-business customers.
Source: [CRISIL Ratings](https://www.crisilratings.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/LendingkartFinanceLimited_November%2004_%202026_RR_409071.html)

### Five-Star: record ₹2,078 crore disbursal, 1% higher yields on new loans
Five-Star Business Finance's Q2 call transcript, filed on 30 Oct, reports record disbursements of ₹2,078 crore (up 74% year on year), AUM of ₹14,640 crore and PAT of ₹299 crore. Gross Stage 3 was 3.48% and 30+ DPD fell to 11.5% from 12.38%. Yields on new loans went up by 1% from October to offset rising funding costs.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a large small-business LAP lender is repricing upward by about 100 bps. That sets a higher pricing reference for small-ticket LAP across the segment, including Muthoot Fincorp's.
Source: [NSE filing (Five-Star)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/FIVESTAR_30102026113317_TranscriptofEarningsConferenceCall.pdf)

### MSME lender stocks: UGRO +3.79%, SBFC +0.64%, Five-Star flat
On 4 Nov UGRO Capital closed at ₹70.92 (+3.79%), SBFC Finance at ₹88.25 (+0.64%) and Five-Star at ₹397.15 (+0.01%). All three trailed the 1.40% rise in the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the market is treating MSME lenders as rate-sensitive this week, behind the gold lenders.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_04112026.csv)

> **Read for Muthoot Fincorp:** Two things are changing in MSME lending at once. RBI's revolving-credit draft is pushing NBFCs to replace redraw facilities with term loans, and rising yields are leading lenders such as Five-Star to raise rates on new loans by about 1%. The MSME, LAP and business-loan lines in Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP face both: product terms that may need rewriting and higher funding costs. Peers' rate increases indicate that higher pricing is being passed through in the segment.

reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Thursday, 5 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

### SEBI allows digital KYC for individual clients resident outside India
SEBI's 4 Nov circular removes the effective requirement that a non-resident individual be in India to finish KYC, so intermediaries can onboard such clients digitally. Intermediaries must pass the KYC information to a KRA within 3 working days. The same process applies to re-KYC, and the circular takes effect for onboarding from 3 Dec 2026.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no lending impact. Non-resident investors seeking its listed NCDs through a demat account may find onboarding easier from December.
Reference: HO/38/30/12(3)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25175/2026 · Addressed to: SEBI-registered intermediaries, stock exchanges, clearing corporations and depositories · Issued: 4 Nov 2026 · Effective: 3 Dec 2026
Source: [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/review-of-know-your-client-process-for-individual-person-resident-outside-india-clients_105603.html)

### No new NBFC instrument from RBI, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND on 4 Nov
RBI's notification feed has nothing after FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB of 2 Nov, and its Master Directions page shows no update after 1 Oct. Its 4 Nov press releases were routine market operations plus the reconstitution of the Technical Consultative Committee for Financial Markets. IBBI's latest circulars are still the two of 30 Oct, and NHB's 4 Nov notice concerns its own term-deposit scheme.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no new compliance action today.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63914)

---

## Latest circulars (last 10 days)

- 4 Nov 2026: SEBI HO/38/30/12(3)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25175/2026: Review of KYC process for individual persons resident outside India ([link](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/review-of-know-your-client-process-for-individual-person-resident-outside-india-clients_105603.html))
- 2 Nov 2026: RBI FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB: FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026 ([link](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13750&Mode=0))

cards.title: Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD bids stood at 2.55x on the closing day
cards.summary: Bids for Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I public NCD stood at 2.55x the ₹200 crore base at 17:00 on 4 Nov, up from 2.36x a day earlier; retail was at 2.32x, HNI 3.62x, NII 1.35x and institutional 0.01x. BSE's cumulative bid sheet showed 254.51% at 17:00 on 4 Nov, and the issue closes today.
cards.impact: bids of 2.55x the base equal about ₹510 crore against the ₹500 crore issue size, so the green-shoe portion is covered on 4 Nov figures; allotment is due on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov.

cards.title: Gold jumps over 3% after the US midterms; listed gold lenders rally up to 7%
cards.summary: Spot gold was up 3.4% at $4,059.95 an ounce at 19:04 GMT on 4 Nov, heading for its biggest daily gain since mid-August, as the dollar fell after Democrats won both houses of the US Congress. On NSE, Muthoot Finance (peer) closed 7.18% higher at ₹2,709.80, IIFL Finance rose 6.77% and Manappuram Finance 3.13%.
cards.impact: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for today rose ₹315 to ₹11,026 a gram, which raises the maximum per-gram amount gold lenders may lend today. The rally coincides with the last day of Muthoot Fincorp's NCD issue.

cards.title: Muthoot Capital Services among October's larger NBFC bond issuers
cards.summary: ETBFSI Research lists Muthoot Capital Services, a separate listed Muthoot Pappachan Group company, alongside Bajaj Finance, Poonawalla Fincorp, Sundaram Finance and Jio Credit as the largest NBFC private-placement borrowers in October. NBFCs as a whole raised ₹24,457 crore, down 19% from September.
cards.impact: a group company is placing debt in a rising-yield month, so investors may compare group paper; Muthoot Fincorp's retail NCD coupons sit against a private-placement curve that has moved up since September.

cards.title: Sensex up 0.50% for a fifth straight gain; Nifty Financial Services up 0.88%
cards.summary: The Sensex closed at 77,301.40 on 4 Nov, up 383.55 points, and the Nifty 50 rose 0.63% to 23,960.60. Nifty Financial Services gained 0.88% to 25,580.60, and the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index rose 1.40% to 29,942.85.
cards.impact: non-bank lenders beat the wider market for a second day, which helps the comparison set for the IPO.

cards.title: Peers: Shriram Finance +2.71%, Bajaj Finance +2.47%; Muthoot Microfin (subsidiary) +3.23%
cards.summary: On NSE, Shriram Finance closed at ₹908.75 (+2.71%) and Bajaj Finance at ₹994.00 (+2.47%). Muthoot Microfin rose ₹4.79 (3.23%) to ₹153.07 ahead of today's Q2 board meeting.
cards.impact: the subsidiary's results today will feed into Muthoot Fincorp's consolidated Q2 numbers.

cards.title: FIIs buy a provisional ₹7,284.03 crore, a fourth straight day
cards.summary: Provisional exchange data show FIIs net bought ₹7,284.03 crore of Indian equities on 4 Nov, their fourth straight day of buying, while DIIs net sold ₹3,712.23 crore. CNBC-TV18 puts FII buying above ₹20,000 crore over the four days.
cards.impact: foreign money is coming back into Indian equities, which is good for the IPO window. It has no direct effect on NCD pricing.

cards.title: Rupee closes at 94.64; Brent falls 8.7% to $94.62
cards.summary: Reuters reports the rupee closed at 94.64 per dollar on 4 Nov, slightly firmer than 94.74 in the previous session. Brent fell 8.7% to settle at $94.62 a barrel, as markets bet the election result makes a US deal with Iran more likely.
cards.impact: an oil drop this large, if it lasts, weakens the case for the December rate hike the market is pricing, and that hike is what is pushing up bank-line costs.

cards.title: SEBI moves KYC for non-resident individual clients online
cards.summary: SEBI circular HO/38/30/12(3)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25175/2026 of 4 Nov lets market intermediaries complete KYC digitally for individual clients resident outside India, without the client being physically in India. It applies from 3 Dec 2026.
cards.impact: none for lending. Non-resident investors in its listed NCDs may find demat onboarding easier from December.

cards.title: CRISIL assigns AA-/Stable to Lendingkart Finance's ₹150 crore NCDs
cards.summary: On 4 Nov CRISIL assigned AA-/Stable to Lendingkart Finance's new ₹150 crore NCDs and reaffirmed its other ratings, citing majority ownership by Fullerton Financial Holdings. It also withdrew a ₹150 crore commercial paper rating at the company's request.
cards.impact: an unsecured MSME lender rated AA- mainly on parent support sits one notch below Muthoot Fincorp's CRISIL AA. Debt investors comparing the two are comparing different bases.

cards.title: NBFC bond raising falls 19% in October as yields hit a four-year high
cards.summary: NBFCs raised ₹24,457 crore through private placements in October, down from ₹30,034 crore in September, and AAA issuers took about 68% of all corporate bond money. The 10-year G-sec touched 7.4983% on 3 Nov, its highest since October 2022, and three-year NABARD yields rose to 8.30–8.33% from 7.88–7.90%.
cards.impact: with AAA names taking most of the money, an AA issuer pays up in placements. Against that, Muthoot Fincorp is currently raising money through a retail public NCD.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Thursday: MSME & commercial lending
cards.title: Update: NBFCs swap revolving MSME lines for term loans before RBI's final rule
cards.summary: ET reports that Bajaj Finance started term-loan variants without redraw on 1 Nov, and Tata Capital is piloting replacements for its flexi loans, about 90% of which go to MSMEs. Shriram Finance's Umesh Revankar puts revolving credit across NBFCs at about ₹2 lakh crore against a total book of roughly ₹30 lakh crore.
cards.impact: business-loan products with a redraw feature, at any lender, would need term-loan versions if RBI's August draft becomes final.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Thursday: MSME & commercial lending
cards.title: Lendingkart lifts its MSME ticket size to ₹17 lakh and plans LAP
cards.summary: CRISIL's 4 Nov rationale says Lendingkart's average ticket on new unsecured MSME loans rose to ₹17 lakh from ₹6–7 lakh, with physical checks added to credit appraisal. It plans a secured loan-against-property product this fiscal.
cards.impact: fintech MSME lenders are moving up-ticket and into LAP, where Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP also plans growth, which points to more competition for the same small-business customers.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Thursday: MSME & commercial lending
cards.title: Five-Star: record ₹2,078 crore disbursal, 1% higher yields on new loans
cards.summary: Five-Star Business Finance's Q2 call transcript, filed on 30 Oct, reports record disbursements of ₹2,078 crore (up 74% year on year), AUM of ₹14,640 crore and PAT of ₹299 crore. Gross Stage 3 was 3.48% and 30+ DPD fell to 11.5% from 12.38%.
cards.impact: a large small-business LAP lender is repricing upward by about 100 bps. That sets a higher pricing reference for small-ticket LAP across the segment, including Muthoot Fincorp's.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Thursday: MSME & commercial lending
cards.title: MSME lender stocks: UGRO +3.79%, SBFC +0.64%, Five-Star flat
cards.summary: On 4 Nov UGRO Capital closed at ₹70.92 (+3.79%), SBFC Finance at ₹88.25 (+0.64%) and Five-Star at ₹397.15 (+0.01%). All three trailed the 1.40% rise in the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index.
cards.impact: the market is treating MSME lenders as rate-sensitive this week, behind the gold lenders.

cards.title: Review of Know Your Client process for individual Person Resident Outside India clients
cards.summary: SEBI's 4 Nov circular removes the effective requirement that a non-resident individual be in India to finish KYC, so intermediaries can onboard such clients digitally. Intermediaries must pass the KYC information to a KRA within 3 working days.

latest_circulars.summary: Reference: SEBI circular HO/(201)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/24467/2026 · 27 Oct 2026 - What it says: - Regulation 9C of the DT Regulations (notified 27 Oct 2025) lets DTs move non-SEBI activities into separate business units (SBUs). - The deadline had already been extended once, to 27 Oct 2026. It now moves out by six months because SEBI's Expert Working Group (set up in June 2026) is reviewing the whole DT framework, SBUs included. - All other provisions of the 25 Nov 2025 circular…
